newsitem.title: USA: Altera cuts certain prices up to 49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Altera cuts certain prices up to 49 pct.

text.p: Altera Corp said Monday it would reduce the list prices of its FLEX 10K and MAX 7000S families of programmable logic devices by up to 49 percent.

Altera said in a separate press release that it was forecasting that ongoing reductions in the size of the devices -- semiconductor chips that offer on-site programmability -- will drive prices down by as much as 50 percent annually through the end of the year 2000.
Altera's stock was up two to 53 in early afternoon trading.
"Programmable logic prices have fallen dramatically in recent years and the reductions are often larger than anticipated by the market," said Erik Cleage, Altera's vice president of marketing.

"Over the coming years, Altera will use advanced process technology to further reduce die size and cost, allowing us to decrease device prices as well as dramatically increase on-chip density, performance and functionality," he said.
